description: The source identifies data underlying the combined-sewer-overflow study for a Mediterranean coastal catchment. It explicitly lists precipitation for 1999–2019, wastewater-treatment influent and effluent quality, and a P-ratio table associated with regional legislation. The related study identifies the Rio Vallescura catchment in central Italy and develops a validated rainfall-runoff and water-quality model for 35 spillways. The supplement is a PDF information source; no extracted measurements or machine-readable file layout were inspected. The rainfall range does not establish the dates of every water-quality measurement. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
